summary: Sets a driver's full name. A bounded string copy (sub_587DD0, max 63 chars) copies the source name a2 into the 64-byte driver name buffer at this + 17952 (offset 0x4620), the final byte at this + 0x465F is forced to zero as the terminator, then DriverAbbreviationNameFormatter derives and stores the abbreviated driver name and its result is returned.

local_names.this: driver record object; the 64-byte full name buffer starts at offset 0x4620 (field evidence at 0x465F is the buffer's final terminator byte)
local_names.v3: alias for this + 17952, the driver name buffer

operations.description: Set v3 = this + 17952, the 64-byte driver full name buffer whose last byte is this + 0x465F.
Call sub_587DD0(this + 17952, a2, 63), a bounded string copy of at most 63 characters from a2 into the driver name buffer.
Force the last buffer byte to zero: v3[63] = 0 at this + 0x465F, guaranteeing NUL termination.
Call DriverAbbreviationNameFormatter(this) to derive and store the abbreviated driver name from the full name field.

sub_587DD0(v3, a2, 63);         // bounded copy, at most 63 chars
v3[63] = 0;                     // force NUL terminator at this + 0x465F
